title: Olink Mapping
text: mapping generated using following steps: Input Data: Raw data sourced Olink Explore Target assay files (CSV Excel formats). Formatting: UniProt IDs Target Gene symbols extracted separated multiple entries existed. Mapping: UniProt IDs HGNC symbols mapped Ensembl Gene IDs using biomaRt (Ensembl dataset hsapiens_gene_ensembl). protein_coding genes retained. standard chromosomes (1-22, X, Y) retained. Mappings filtered ensure consistency UniProt gene symbols Entrez/HGNC/External gene names. Genomic Positions: Start End positions retrieved hg19 hg38 builds using TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene.

title: SomaLogic Mapping
text: metadata_GRCh38_p14_somalogic contains SomaLogic assay identifiers associated UniProt accessions. Protein genomic annotations provided separately mapping_GRCh38_p14_uniprot.

title: SomaLogic Mapping
text: mapping generated using following steps: Input Data: files matching example_data*.adat SomaLogic GitHub repository downloaded. current files V4, V4.1, V5.0 examples; filenames checksums retained metadata. Split multiple entries UniProt, Entrez Gene ID, Entrez Gene Symbol. Filtered Human organism . Filtered Protein type (removing controls). Excluded entries flagged “internal use ”. Protein annotations: UniProt accessions joined mapping_GRCh38_p14_uniprot using UNIPROT.

title: SomaLogic Mapping
text: assay SeqId can linked multiple UniProt accessions. Keep SeqId-UNIPROT relationship joining assay measurements; join can produce multiple rows per assay.

title: Useful Data Sets
text: shared dataset maps UniProt accessions gene identifiers genomic positions. mapping use Olink data, uses UniProt accessions identifiers, protein-level reference SomaLogic data. Columns include: - UNIPROT: UniProt accession - ensembl_gene_id: Ensembl Gene ID - hgnc_id / hgnc_symbol: HGNC identifiers - START_hg19 / END_hg19: Genomic coordinates (hg19) - START_hg38 / END_hg38: Genomic coordinates (hg38) accession can one row source mapping contains multiple distinct annotation records. Check duplicate UNIPROT values assuming one--one join.

title: Useful Data Sets
text: dataset contains metadata extracted public example ADATs listed SomaLogic-Data repository, source filename checksum recorded per row. currently includes V4, V4.1, V5.0 examples; newly listed example_data*.adat files included metadata refreshed. examples package’s reference inventory, guarantee full commercial menu coverage. Join metadata shared mapping using UNIPROT. Columns include: - SeqId: Sequence ID - SomaId: SomaLogic ID - ExampleADAT: Source example ADAT filename - ADAT_MD5: Checksum exact downloaded ADAT - UNIPROT: UniProt ID - Target: Gene Symbol - TargetFullName: Full target name - EntrezGeneID / EntrezGeneSymbol: Source Entrez identifiers SomaLogic assay can map multiple UniProt accessions, assay may appear multiple example files. Keep ExampleADAT-SeqId-UNIPROT relationship joining assay measurements; joining may produce multiple rows assay.
